description.text: The other tenth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Time Gazer on 8 April 2022, with more Pokémon of the Hisui region. Space Juggler holds Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power, the Ability Star Portal, attaches up to three Water Energy from the discard pile to its player's Water Pokémon, with the Supporter Irida, which takes a Water Pokémon and an Item from the deck. Kleavor VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon in its player's discard pile, Heatran VMAX, Beedrill V, Hisuian Sneasler V, Oranguru V, Hisuian Decidueye and Bastiodon join it, with the Supporters Grant and Choy. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 67, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR, Heatran VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR, Temple of Sinnoh and Double Turbo Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Astral Radiance in May 2022, and some in Lost Origin in September 2022.
